title: Chicken Karahi (Spicy Chicken with Tomato and Ginger)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A street-stall dish usually cooked in big woks over fierce heat and eaten on the spot with naan. This frying-pan version is very gingery. The author eats it with bread and maybe raita, never rice, and with more chilies than listed.

steps.action: Heat in a large frying pan over high, 2 min:
Add half of each; fry 2 min, until the ginger just darkens and smells fried:
items: 6 cu in ginger (2 × 3 × 15 cm), peeled, in ⅛ in (3 mm) dice
6 green chilies (or 2 jalapeños), in thin rings, with seeds

steps.action: Add and fry 5 min, stirring, until no pink remains and the released water is mostly gone:
items: 1¾ lb boneless chicken thighs (800 g; breasts ok), in ⅓ in (1 cm) cubes

steps.action: Add and fry 2 min, stirring (all steps so far on max heat):
Mix in; reduce to medium-high (7/10) and cook 15 min, stirring occasionally, until the oil separates and floats:
items: 3 medium tomatoes, chopped (or 14 oz / 400 g can)

steps.action: Add; cover and cook on medium-low (3/10) 15 min:
Stir in; turn off heat, cover, and rest 5 min:
